lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic crystal Mg2Ga2B4 (reduced formula MgGaB2) adopts space group Pnnm (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies boron centers with three geometric neighbors (2 B, 1 Ga), gallium centers with ten neighbors (4 B, 3 Ga, 3 Mg), and magnesium centers with twelve neighbors (8 B, 4 Ga). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Ga and Mg polyhedra sharing edges and faces, and B polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
